turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Real Madrid were dead and buried at three-one down against AS Roma. Then three goals in seven manic minutes! Absolute madness.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Good morning. What an unbelievable finish in the Champions League.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: I still cannot wrap my head around that Madrid match. My heart was in my mouth when Malen made it three-one.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: How on earth did they turn that around from three-one down?

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Pure Champions League madness! AS Roma took the lead at twenty minutes through Marten de Roon from Matìas Soulè. Kylian Mbappé leveled five minutes later from Yan Diomande. But early in the second half, AS Roma tore through our defence. Donyell Malen scored in the fifty-first from Rodrigo Mora, and struck again in the fifty-seventh, Soulè setting him up again. Three-one down. Madrid had three straight wins coming in, but we looked done.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Then the eighty-third minute arrived.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Carlos Espí scores to make it two-three. Two minutes later, Arda Güler crosses and Endrick heads home the equalizer! Then in the ninetieth, Güler finds Antonio Rüdiger for a volleyed winner! Four-three!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Jose Mourinho gets a dramatic win on his return against AS Roma. He said afterwards that Real Madrid were impossible to stop and AS Roma's players were dead.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: They could not stop that surge! It was Mbappé’s hundredth Champions League appearance too. But the massive headache right now is off the pitch.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: You mean the Vinicius Junior suspension?

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Four matches! He misses El Clasico against Barcelona on October twenty-fifth!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Four games for pulling hair?

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Nathan Saliba’s hair! Against Villarreal, Vini came on in the fifty-second minute, thought he scored twenty minutes later, and then VAR intervened. Disallowed goal, red card. The committee gave him two games for violent conduct without the ball, and two extra games for arguing aggressively with the referee while teammates restrained him!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: That rules him out against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing Santander, and Valencia.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Mourinho skipped the post-match press conference, but told TNT Sports Brazil it is only a matter of time before Vini returns to his best. He backed him completely, saying he decided to help him after the Atletico Madrid derby. Vini signed a new deal this summer, turning down Arsenal, but his form has really dipped.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: The timing is brutal because authorities declared that Clasico at Spotify Camp Nou a high-risk fixture. Hansi Flick’s Barcelona sit top with ten wins from ten matches across all competitions. Real Madrid are fourth, six points back, having already lost to Real Betis and Atletico Madrid.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: A loss there spells real trouble for the title race. But if Madrid brought joy, Hyderabad brought utter heartbreak.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: West Indies beat India by twenty-four runs in the fourth T20 international.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: I am gutted. Why did India bowl first on that pitch?

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: India went in unchanged and chased, hoping the refreshed Uppal track would behave differently. Instead, it was that same batting paradise.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: West Indies made two changes and smashed two hundred and forty-seven for three! Shai Hope broke Chris Gayle’s record and joined Kohli in an elite list. India fell twenty-four runs short, bowled out for two hundred and twenty-three in nineteen point three overs. Even Keemo Paul celebrating Naman Dhir's wicket stung.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: That ties the five-match series at two-all heading to Saturday's decider in Bengaluru. Can India bounce back?

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: They must. In the third match, India won by fourteen runs because Abhishek Sharma smashed sixty-nine off thirty balls. Cheteshwar Pujara was on JioStar comparing Abhishek's eighteen-ball fifty to Chris Gayle! But our bowling in Hyderabad just collapsed.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: On the women’s side, Smriti Mandhana begins as full-time captain on Friday in Raipur against Zimbabwe.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Only Mithali Raj and Harmanpreet Kaur held that full-time role over the last fourteen years. Mandhana is twenty-nine now, taking over after back-to-back early exits in T20 World Cups.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: They have three T20Is and three ODIs against Zimbabwe, preparing for the Women's Champions Trophy in February 2027. Mandhana said this bilateral will establish a clear blueprint for their T20 approach.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: A fresh start was needed. Hopefully this sets the tone.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In Formula One, Laurent Mekies signed a contract extension to remain Red Bull CEO and Team Principal through 2031.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Deserved. Mekies arrived from Racing Bulls in July 2025, worked through a tough start, and Max Verstappen just delivered back-to-back wins in Malaysia and Singapore.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: That Baku upgrade in round fifteen made the RB22 predictable and driveable again. But Max faces a huge change on his pit wall.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: GianPiero Lambiase has been Max’s race engineer since 2016! He is moving to McLaren as chief racing officer no later than 2028.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Tom Hart will stand in for Lambiase for three races starting in Austin, before taking over full-time from 2027. Hart chose Red Bull over Williams.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: And Max is racing in Portimão this weekend in the GT World Challenge Endurance finale, driving a Mercedes AMG GT3 EVO against Valentino Rossi in a BMW M4 GT3 EVO.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In tennis, Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic will not play the Six Kings Slam in Riyadh next week. It is postponed to late December.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Houthi attacks targeted Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport, so safety pushed it back. But finishing on December thirtieth leaves players forty-eight hours before the 2027 season starts with the United Cup in Australia!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Andy Roddick noted that Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner are paying a physical bill. Alcaraz missed the French Open and Wimbledon with a wrist injury, while Sinner ended his season early with a knee issue after winning Wimbledon.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In NBA preseason from Las Vegas, Golden State Warriors beat the Los Angeles Lakers one hundred and one to eighty-nine.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Any bright spots without the starters?

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg impressed with seventeen points, five rebounds, and four assists in under twenty-four minutes. Golden State rallied from a big deficit without Kristaps Porzingis or Al Horford, while Luka Doncic sat for the Lakers.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Kerr tried that five-out alignment, but Porzingis remains out indefinitely with an unspecified health issue. He signed that two-year, forty-million-dollar deal, missed camp, and posted that bizarre social media update dismissing online speculation.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: At the Shanghai Masters, Daniil Medvedev beat Stefanos Tsitsipas six-four, seven-five. Medvedev is only the fourth man to reach three consecutive Shanghai quarterfinals, alongside Roger Federer, Novak Djokovic, and Andy Murray.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Djokovic won Beijing last week for his hundred and second career title after Medvedev was defaulted in the semifinals and Alex de Minaur retired in the final with a groin injury.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Also in Shanghai, twenty-year-old Rafael Jodar made the quarterfinals by beating Botic van de Zandschulp, but picked up a code violation for swearing at a ball kid for a towel.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: And Rennae Stubbs thinks Alcaraz’s wrist injury came from copying Djokovic’s serve motion.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In football, Harry Kane scored twice in Bayern Munich’s three-three draw to reach four hundred and fifty career goals. Kane has now scored in nine straight Champions League games, closing in on Cristiano Ronaldo’s record of eleven.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: He is tied with Thomas Müller on fifty-seven tournament goals. Yet Kane was still unhappy with the draw!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In Formula One, Kimi Antonelli admitted it would be scary if Verstappen were in the title fight. Antonelli could seal the championship in Austin if he outscores George Russell by twenty-three points and Lewis Hamilton by fourteen.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Max will certainly keep sharp, tackling over sixty cars in that three-hour GT race in Portimão.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Elsewhere in the Champions League, Club Brugge pulled off a four-three win away against Internazionale in a seven-goal thriller.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Inter beaten at home by Brugge! What a collapse for the Italian side.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: And Bodo/Glimt bounced back from their thrashing at Bayern by shocking Borussia Dortmund one-nil.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Dortmund beaten by Bodo/Glimt! European nights never fail to surprise.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: For the fixtures in Indian Standard Time, Saturday morning starts at seven-thirty AM with Golden State Warriors facing the Portland Trail Blazers in preseason.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Then on Saturday at seven PM, India face the West Indies at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru for the series decider.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: On Monday at twelve-thirty AM, Real Madrid host Sevilla in La Liga at the Santiago Bernabéu.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Followed by RB Leipzig visiting the Bernabéu on Thursday at twelve-thirty AM in the Champions League.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: An enormous weekend ahead of us.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Chinnaswamy on Saturday night is going to be electric.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: That's the show. Same time tomorrow.

turns.text: Also in Shanghai, twenty-year-old Rafael Jodar made the quarterfinals by beating Botic van de Zandschulp, but picked up a code violation for swearing at a ball kid for a towel.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: And Rennae Stubbs thinks Alcaraz’s wrist injury came from copying Djokovic’s serve motion.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In football, Harry Kane scored twice in Bayern Munich’s three-three draw to reach four hundred and fifty career goals. Kane has now scored in nine straight Champions League games, closing in on Cristiano Ronaldo’s record of eleven.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: He is tied with Thomas Müller on fifty-seven tournament goals. Yet Kane was still unhappy with the draw!

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: In Formula One, Kimi Antonelli admitted it would be scary if Verstappen were in the title fight. Antonelli could seal the championship in Austin if he outscores George Russell by twenty-three points and Lewis Hamilton by fourteen.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Max will certainly keep sharp, tackling over sixty cars in that three-hour GT race in Portimão.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: Elsewhere in the Champions League, Club Brugge pulled off a four-three win away against Internazionale in a seven-goal thriller.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Inter beaten at home by Brugge! What a collapse for the Italian side.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: And Bodo/Glimt bounced back from their thrashing at Bayern by shocking Borussia Dortmund one-nil.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Dortmund beaten by Bodo/Glimt! European nights never fail to surprise.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: For the fixtures in Indian Standard Time, Saturday morning starts at seven-thirty AM with Golden State Warriors facing the Portland Trail Blazers in preseason.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Then on Saturday at seven PM, India face the West Indies at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru for the series decider.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: On Monday at twelve-thirty AM, Real Madrid host Sevilla in La Liga at the Santiago Bernabéu.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Followed by RB Leipzig visiting the Bernabéu on Thursday at twelve-thirty AM in the Champions League.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: An enormous weekend ahead of us.

turns.speaker: Fan
turns.text: Chinnaswamy on Saturday night is going to be electric.

turns.speaker: Anchor
turns.text: That's the show. Same time tomorrow.
